mechanism: 주택담보대출 금리 하락의 변화가 채용·고용 유지·구직 여건 경로를 통해 실업률의 감소로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R08039의 적용 맥락: This paper examines U.S. 30‑year fixed-rate mortgage borrowers and county-level outcomes using loan-level CoreLogic data (benchmark 1995–2007) and Freddie Mac records. Units are individual mortgages/households and counties across the United States. The study focuses on how cross-sectional and time-series variation in potential savings from refinancing shapes monetary policy transmission, exploiting high-frequency FOMC announcement surprises and county panel variation to instrument mortgage-rate changes and estimating impacts on refinancing, cash-out extraction, consumption proxies, unemployment, and housing permits.
